lines.text: The roof splits under your feet.
Behind you, your house goes under.
Floating cars come out of the dark.
It misses your head by inches.
A highway, still above the water.
YOU MADE IT! GRAB MY HAND!
Would you have jumped? Tell me in the comments.
The helicopter ending is the other part two.
